description: Dar begins searching for the enslaved Kyra with Tao at his side, using his bond with animals against Terrons, sorcerers, demons and creatures that threaten both people and the natural world.

s01e01.description: Dar befriends Tao and begins his quest to rescue his long-lost love Kyra, who has been kidnapped and enslaved by the Terrons.

s01e02.description: Dar teams with banished Terron warrior Akili to rescue Kyra, unaware that Akili has also fallen in love with her.

s01e03.description: Dar uses the help of his animal allies to rescue Tao from an island inhabited by murderous Birdmen.

s01e04.description: After Dar is finally reunited with Kyra, the Sorceress captures her again.

s01e05.description: Dar races into a valley inhabited by Amazons to retrieve a rare fire lily needed to save a young woman’s life.

s01e06.description: Dar and a young boy persuade the animal guardian Curupira to spare the boy’s tribe if they learn to respect the rainforest.

s01e07.description: Dar must stop the killing rampage of the formidable warrior Nokinja, whose strength is secretly enhanced by the demon Ketzwayo.

s01e08.description: Dar and Tao try to save the last unicorns from Terrons seeking the magical healing properties of their horns.

s01e09.description: Ketzwayo returns from the dead with magic intended to kill Dar and devastate the animal kingdom of the Mydlands.

s01e10.description: Dar must rescue the nymph who supplies the Fountain of Youth from a brutal Venatu warrior.

s01e11.description: With a shaman’s help, Dar journeys to the realm of memories and confronts the slaughter of his Sula tribe.

s01e12.description: Dar’s devotion to Kyra is tested when he is drawn to Zuraya, an animal trainer cursed with loneliness by the Ancient One.

s01e13.description: Dar reluctantly accepts the Sorceress’s help to rescue Tao from King Zad’s ferocious Minotaur.

s01e14.description: Dar and Tao must stop a dangerous pilgrim who gains possession of liquid rock capable of controlling life and death.

s01e15.description: Dar and Tao protect a mystical baby from King Zad, who believes the child is destined to cause his downfall.

s01e16.description: Dar meets Atlantia, a woman from a mute amphibious race, and must find a way to communicate with her to save Tao.

s01e17.description: While investigating a young friend’s death, Dar learns that a tribe of divers believes its ancestral guardians live on as dolphins.

s01e18.description: When the Black Apparition captures the Sorceress, Sharak takes human form and asks Dar to help rescue her.

s01e19.description: The Golden Phoenix assumes the human form of Prince Garuda to exact revenge on Dar.

s01e20.description: Dar and Tao race to identify a mysterious force killing both people and animals throughout the forest.

s01e21.description: Dar and Tao learn that the Terrons have captured Kyra again and set out to free her.

s01e22.description: Qord vows to kill Dar and seize Kyra as part of his revenge against King Zad.
